title.narrative: In 2024, 251,676 birth certificates were issued through health and civil registration coordination. Joint monitoring of detention facilities enabled legal aid for 464 children. UNICEF-Burundi supported the rollout of child protection case management, which will continue in 2025, strengthening legal and social safeguards for vulnerable children.
